_note: Descriptions for the Information Packages and the derived packages that subset them. The group is what the workbook's own heading row says and is authoritative. A key may be qualified by its package (bip-dec:upu) where the same abbreviation names a different message in two packages. The gloss expands an abbreviation the workbook never spells out; where the source is 'editorial' it is our wording, not WCO's, and should be checked before publication. Where a message's column heading changed between releases, the later entry lists the earlier headings in aliases and explains the join in alias_note; that join is editorial.

bip-dec.title: Declaration
bip-dec.subtitle: Base Information Package
bip-dec.description: Business to government submissions: import and export customs declarations, cargo reports and transit declarations.

bip-lpco.title: LPCO
bip-lpco.subtitle: Base Information Package
bip-lpco.description: Licences, permits, certificates and other documents, such as a certificate of origin or a phytosanitary certificate.

aip.title: Additional
aip.subtitle: Additional Information Package
aip.description: A wrapper around business information held in a Base Information Package: Response for government to business, Intergov for government to government. Its relationship to a BIP is composition, not association.

mdip.title: Meta Data
mdip.subtitle: Meta Data Information Package
mdip.description: The technical aspect of a data exchange, separated so the other packages carry only business content.

mar-api.name: Maritime API
mar-api.gloss: Advance Passenger Information for maritime arrivals and departures, aligned to the IMO FAL forms.
mar-api.alias_note: Headed API in 4.0.0 and 4.1.0, absent from 4.2.0, and Mar. API in 4.3.0. Treated here as one message on the strength of the name alone, since the position count changed. Our judgement, not a statement by WCO.

mar-bri.name: Maritime BRI
mar-bri.gloss: Booking Reservation Information. Added in WCO Data Model 4.1.0 for the cruise industry.
mar-bri.alias_note: Headed BRI in 4.1.0 and 4.2.0 and Mar. BRI in 4.3.0. Treated here as one message: the two carry the same 144 positions. Our judgement, not a statement by WCO.

upu-cusitm.name: UPU CUSITM
upu-cusitm.gloss: The Universal Postal Union message by which a postal operator sends mail item information to its local customs authority.

upu-refrsp.name: UPU REFRSP
upu-refrsp.gloss: One of the WCO-UPU joint message standards version 2, alongside CUSITM and CUSRSP. The workbook does not spell the abbreviation out.

coo-wco-tcro.name: Certificate of Origin
coo-wco-tcro.gloss: Certificate of Origin, under the WCO Technical Committee on Rules of Origin.

customs-bond.name: Customs Bond
customs-bond.gloss: A customs bond: the guarantee lodged against duties and taxes.

etir.name: eTIR
etir.gloss: The UNECE eTIR international system, which carries TIR transit data between customs administrations.

sstl.name: SSTL
sstl.gloss: Smart and Secure Trade Lanes, the customs to customs exchange piloted on selected trade lanes.

aeo-master-data.name: AEO Master Data
aeo-master-data.gloss: The master data describing an Authorised Economic Operator, exchanged between administrations.
aeo-master-data.alias_note: Spelt AEO MasterData before 4.2.0 and AEO Master Data after. One message.

aeomra.name: AEOMRA
aeomra.gloss: Authorised Economic Operator Mutual Recognition Arrangement: the exchange that lets one administration recognise another's AEOs. Marked work in progress in the workbook.

cntrl.name: CNTRL
cntrl.gloss: Control: a response telling the declarant that the goods or the declaration have been selected for control.

inf.name: INF
inf.gloss: Information: a response carrying information rather than a decision.

bussval.name: BUSSVAL
bussval.gloss: Business validation: a response reporting whether the submission passed the business rules.

techval.name: TECHVAL
techval.gloss: Technical validation: a response reporting whether the submission was well formed and schema valid.

sta.name: STA
sta.gloss: Status: a response reporting the current state of a declaration.

upu-cusres.name: UPU CUSRES
upu-cusres.gloss: The Universal Postal Union response to a CUSITM message. The workbook spells it CUSRES in the column and CUSRSP2 in the heading above it.
upu-cusres.alias_note: The Response package's postal message: headed UPU in 4.0.0 to 4.2.0, UPU CUSRSP in the 4.1.0 detail block and UPU CUSRES in 4.3.0. One message. The Declaration package's UPU is a different message and stays separate.

cites.name: CITES
cites.gloss: The electronic permit of the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora. Carried in 4.0.0 and 4.1.0.

ecoo.name: eCoO
ecoo.gloss: Electronic Certificate of Origin. The Overall Information Structure heads the same column EU CoO.

atiga-coo.name: ATIGA CoO
atiga-coo.gloss: Certificate of Origin under the ASEAN Trade in Goods Agreement.

etir-guar.name: eTIR Guarantee
etir-guar.gloss: The guarantee message of the UNECE eTIR international system.

etir-carv.name: eTIR CARV
etir-carv.gloss: An eTIR carnet message. The Overall Information Structure heads the column TIR CARV and neither sheet spells the abbreviation out.

ecoc.name: eCoC
ecoc.gloss: Electronic Certificate of Conformity. The Overall Information Structure heads the same column EU CoC.

codex.name: Codex
codex.gloss: The Codex Alimentarius model certificate for food exports.

e-phyto.name: ePhyto
e-phyto.gloss: The electronic phytosanitary certificate of the International Plant Protection Convention. The workbook's detail columns for it are headed IPPC.

unesco-cert.name: UNESCO Certificate
unesco-cert.gloss: The export certificate for cultural objects. The workbook heads its detail block Cultural Objects.

eata.name: eATA
eata.gloss: The ATA Carnet for temporary admission. The workbook heads its detail block eATA Carnet Data.

oie-cert.name: OIE Certificate
oie-cert.gloss: The international veterinary certificate of the World Organisation for Animal Health, which was the OIE when this release was published. The workbook heads its detail block OIE Model.

bip-dec:aei.name: AEI
bip-dec:aei.gloss: A Declaration subset the workbook heads DIP AEI and never spells out.

bip-dec:api.name: API
bip-dec:api.gloss: Advance Passenger Information. Carried as its own derived package until 4.1.0; 4.3.0 carries the same ground as Maritime API.

bip-dec:dv1.name: DV1
bip-dec:dv1.gloss: The customs valuation declaration, the form known as DV1.

bip-dec:irg.name: IRG
bip-dec:irg.gloss: A Declaration subset the workbook heads IRG and never spells out.

bip-dec:msw.name: MSW
bip-dec:msw.gloss: Maritime Single Window. The workbook heads its detail block DIP MSW (B2MSW), business to Maritime Single Window.

bip-dec:sad.name: SAD
bip-dec:sad.gloss: The Single Administrative Document. The workbook heads its detail block DIP SAD (SARS).

bip-dec:upu.name: UPU
bip-dec:upu.gloss: The Universal Postal Union declaration message, which 4.2.0 splits into UPU CUSITM and UPU REFRSP.

bip-dec:val.name: VAL
bip-dec:val.gloss: Valuation. The Overall Information Structure heads the neighbouring column Validation in 4.1.0, which is one of the two.

bip-dec:bri.name: Maritime BRI
bip-dec:bri.gloss: Booking Reservation Information. Added in WCO Data Model 4.1.0 for the cruise industry, and headed Mar. BRI from 4.3.0.

aeo-masterdata.name: AEO Master Data
aeo-masterdata.gloss: The master data describing an Authorised Economic Operator, exchanged between administrations. Spelt AEO MasterData before 4.2.0.

aip:msw.name: MSW
aip:msw.gloss: The Maritime Single Window response. The workbook heads its detail block MSW SW2B, Single Window to business.

aip:upu.name: UPU
aip:upu.gloss: The Universal Postal Union response, headed UPU CUSRSP in 4.1.0 and UPU CUSRES from 4.3.0.

aip:api.name: API
aip:api.gloss: An Advance Passenger Information response, carried only in 4.0.0.
